title: Phone Nook
what: Dictation as you speak: the audio streams in 100 ms pieces and the words appear while it plays, first as guesses, then settled. Two small dictation models, side by side.

inputs.label: Caller
inputs.value: Otto, a house voice, played in at real speed

inputs.label: Models
inputs.value: Whisper tiny and Parakeet TDT v3 (sherpa-onnx, on this PC)

inputs.label: Results
inputs.value: Whisper tiny: 0% word errors · Parakeet TDT v3: 0% word errors

snippet:
import json, websockets.sync.client as wsc
url = "ws://127.0.0.1:3900/ws/transcribe?pcm=1&sr=16000&model=sherpa-parakeet-tdt-v3"
with wsc.connect(url) as ws:
    for chunk in microphone():  # 16-bit PCM, 16 kHz
        ws.send(chunk)
    ws.send("EOF")
    print(json.loads(ws.recv()))  # {"type": "partial" | "final", "text": ...}
checks: Both sessions ran at real time on this PC
